summary: Independent verification after rollback rebuild. All 4 backend tasks passed. Unit tests (test_rebuild.py, 4/4) and new E2E tests (test_e2e_upload.py, 3/3) both green. Haldensleben SDU format detected correctly (STREET_NAME/NUMBER/NUMBER_AFFIX/DISTRICT/PLZ/MUNICIPALITY), hierarchical sort produces contiguous Ortsteil blocks starting with the northernmost (Uthmöden before Haldensleben), Lange Straße of different Ortsteile are not merged, house numbers ascending, and street_city_key contains the Ortsteil. Legacy German-column format (Straße/Hausnummer/PLZ/Ort, Worpswede) still processes and exports. Excel export endpoint /api/optimized/{job_id}/export returns HTTP 200 with all original columns preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3925 lines — should be split into modules (routers, geocoding, optimization, column-detection). Column-detection block is duplicated 6x across the file; consolidate into a single helper.
Job status endpoint is /api/job/{job_id} (singular) while some request text mentioned /api/jobs/{job_id}; consider aliasing or documenting to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral upload jobs created via /api/upload-optimized (Haldensleben-format 6 addresses, Legacy Worpswede 4 addresses). Both cleaned up automatically from upload_jobs and routes collections via pytest module-scoped fixture. Real user job e3dbe9db-6710-48d5-9306-39b12841c24e untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_upload.py; they upload tiny XLSX files (<=6 rows) to /api/upload-optimized, poll /api/job/{job_id} until completed, verify Mongo 'routes' doc and /api/optimized/{job_id}/export. Cleanup fixture removes created docs. Geocoding runs ~1 addr/sec, so keep test files small. Job status endpoint is singular /api/job/{job_id}. Uthmöden lies north of Haldensleben, so any Haldensleben-format test file must place Uthmöden first in optimized order.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found. Rebuild is verified: (1) column-detection loop correctly maps STREET_NAME/NUMBER/NUMBER_AFFIX/DISTRICT/PLZ/MUNICIPALITY, (2) optimize_geographic_route groups by Ortsteil first (northernmost lat) then by street inside each OT, (3) clean_street_name only strips digit-containing prefixes so German prepositions Vor/Hinter survive, (4) street_city_key composite includes Ortsteil preventing cross-OT merging.
